from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class PaperCitation(BaseModel):
    """One provided paper: its own title and the titles of other provided papers it references."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The title of the current paper being processed")
    referenced_provided_papers: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of the OTHER provided papers that appear in this paper's reference list")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    papers: list[PaperCitation]
